_published_faq.name: How do I add Fresha to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fresha to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.fresha.com/claude.

_published_faq.name: Is Fresha MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, Fresha scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fresha MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fresha provides these MCP tools: find_beauty_wellness_availability and find_beauty_wellness_venues.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fresha?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fresha in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Fresha does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Why is Fresha failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fresha scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is Authenticated MCP access is available. Reconnect the server account or provide a valid refreshable OAuth session, then rerun the audit. Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Fresha is developed by Fresha. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
